pages.title: I. Early Game
pages.text: $(bold)Trees are locked at first.$(br2)$(li)1. Live off the soft ground, wild plants and raw food.$(br)$(li)2. Buy $(l:paths/woodcutter)Woodcutter$(n) first: logs, planks, wooden tools and the crafting table.$(br)$(li)3. Then $(l:paths/quarry)Quarry$(n) for stone and the first tools.

pages.title: I. Early Game
pages.text: $(bold)Bare hands will not break logs, planks or stone.$(br2)$(li)1. Dig gravel: sometimes $(thing)raw flint$(n).$(br)$(li)2. Right-click raw flint on stone to knap it: $(thing)flint$(n), or $(thing)flint shards$(n) if it breaks.$(br)$(li)3. Flint + stick: $(thing)flint knife$(n).$(br)$(li)4. Use the knife on grass: $(thing)plant fibre$(n).$(br)$(li)5. Two fibre: $(thing)fibre rope$(n).$(br)$(li)6. Flint + rope + stick: $(thing)flint axe$(n).

pages.title: Flint Axe
pages.text: $(bold)Now you can cut wood, once you own $(l:paths/woodcutter)Woodcutter$(n).

pages.title: Wooden Tools
pages.text: $(bold)Wooden tools need $(thing)tough blocks of wood$(n), not planks.$(br2)$(li)Knife in your main hand, a log or plank in your off-hand, right-click: $(thing)block of wood$(n).$(br)$(li)Place a $(thing)pile of fibre$(n) and right-click it with a stick to light it.$(br)$(li)Right-click blocks of wood on the fire, or cook them, to toughen them.

pages.title: Pile of Fibre
pages.text: $(bold)Seven fibre. Light it with a stick.

pages.title: Tough Block of Wood
pages.text: $(bold)Or right-click a block of wood on a lit pile of fibre.

pages.title: Wooden Pickaxe
pages.text: $(bold)Tough blocks of wood and sticks. Every wooden tool works the same way, once you own $(l:paths/woodcutter)Woodcutter$(n).

pages.title: Gravel
pages.text: $(bold)Failed flint is not wasted: shards make gravel to dig again.

pages.title: Light Burns Out
pages.text: $(bold)Torches are crafted $(thing)unlit$(n), burn down while lit, and go out.$(br2)$(li)Light one from a lit torch, a campfire, flint and steel, or a fire starter.$(br)$(li)A burning torch dims to $(thing)smouldering$(n), then $(thing)burnt$(n). A burnt one can be relit.$(br)$(li)A torch lasts about an hour, a lantern about four.$(br)$(li)Water puts them out. Carry spares.

pages.title: Unlit Torch
pages.text: $(bold)Coal and a stick, same as ever; it just does not light itself.

pages.title: Fire Starter
pages.text: $(bold)String and three sticks. Lights torches and campfires with no flint needed. It cannot light lanterns.

pages.title: Lanterns and Oil
pages.text: $(bold)Lanterns burn fuel too, and are refilled with an $(thing)oil can$(n): coal or animal fat. A fire starter will not light them; use a torch, campfire or flint and steel.$(br2)$(li)Lanterns and the oil can: $(l:paths/ironworks)Ironworks$(n), ring 4.$(br)$(li)Animal fat: $(l:paths/husbandry)Husbandry$(n), ring 2.$(br)$(li)The bandolier carries torches: Ironworks, ring 4.
